summary: Procure 25 ScribePro pilot seats for Docs & CS teams (quarterly pilot)
description: Issue summary: Request to procure a 3-month pilot of ScribePro (documentation capture + automated playbook generation) for Docs and Customer Success. Impact: Enables faster creation of onboarding guides and support playbooks; blocking Docs roadmap item if unavailable. This ticket coordinates procurement, legal review, SCIM/SSO provisioning, and cost-center allocation.
impact: Docs team cannot complete the internal playbook automation POC; CS will delay canned response improvements. Low revenue impact but high operational efficiency importance.
request_details: Quantity: 25 seats. Seat types: 15 Editor seats (Docs), 10 Contributor seats (CS). Duration: 3-month pilot starting ASAP. Features required: SCIM provisioning, SSO (Okta), exportable audit logs, workspace-level role controls. Vendor quoted early-stage pilot pricing and a standard EULA; vendor requests Redwood PO and MSA signature for pilots over 20 seats.
justification: We need ScribePro for automated knowledge capture to reduce time-to-doc by ~40% in small trials. Team leads have run a 2-week eval (internal trial) and reported substantial productivity gains. Pilot will produce measurable metrics (time-to-first-doc, number of playbooks produced) to present to procurement for a larger annual purchase.
cost_estimate: $3,750 for 3 months (pilot quote: $50/seat/month for editors, $25/seat/month for contributors); vendor requires upfront invoice for pilot
approvals_required: Legal sign-off on MSA; Procurement PO approval; Finance cost-center signoff; Security questionnaire review for data handling
procurement_steps: 1) Confirm final seat counts and billing contact. 2) Submit PO request to Procurement via Coupa. 3) Send vendor MSA to Legal for review (attach redlines). 4) After PO/Legal approval, Procurement will issue purchase order and procurement will request vendor invoice. 5) IT to configure SSO/SCIM and create group mappings. 6) Onboarding handoff to Docs for pilot kickoff.
estimated_timeline: PO submission target: 2026-03-12. Legal review complete: 2026-03-16. PO issued: 2026-03-17. Onboarding/SSO planned: 2026-03-20 to 2026-03-24.
